description:
Create a 3D model of a concrete staircase in FreeCAD. The staircase must have exactly 10 steps. 

Specifications:
- Single Step Dimensions: Width (X) = 1000 mm, Run/Depth (Y) = 280 mm, Rise/Height (Z) = 180 mm.
- Arrangement: The steps must form a continuous straight flight (linear pattern). Each subsequent step is positioned 280mm forward (Y) and 180mm up (Z) from the previous one.
- Result: The final model must be a single fused object or compound containing all 10 steps.

Save the completed model to '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/staircase.FCStd'.
